projects.description: List of {@link ReliabilityMl.Project}s for which the workflow should be created.

automatedRetrainingJobOptions.description: Configuration {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.JobOptions} for executing the retraining workflow, such as concurrency limits and timeouts.

postTrainingJobOptions.description: Configuration {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.JobOptions} for executing post-training, such as concurrency limits and timeouts.

doNotClassify.description:
Specify whether to classify the model after it is trained. By default this
field is set to False, meaning the model will be classified.

doNotValidate.description:
Specify whether to validate the model after it is trained. By default this
field is set to True, meaning the model will not be validated.

doNotGenerateValidationReports.description:
Specify whether to generate model validation reports for the model after it is trained.
By default this field is set to False, meaning that a model report will be generated.

title:
Defines the specification for an end-to-end automated model retraining workflow across multiple {@link ReliabilityMl.Project}s.

This specification enables orchestration of a multi-stage retraining pipeline, including:
- Selection of champion models from each project using custom {@link ReliabilityMl.Project#filterModelsForAutoRetrainingLambda} lambdas.
- Configuration and execution of {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.AutomatedRetrainingJob} runs for the selected {@link ReliabilityMlModel}s.
- Deployment of retrained models and updates to {@link ReliabilityAssetToModelRelation} with the retraining job ID.
- Launching of {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.PostTrainingJob} instances to evaluate retrained models and generate reports.

Enables full automation and traceability for the retraining lifecycle, including model selection, retraining, deployment, and post-training evaluation.
name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.AutomatedRetrainingWorkflowSpec
